lead: Tuesday belonged to Meta's Muse - as a security story. Patrick Wardle disclosed a [zero-day in the Muse macOS app](../summaries/16444d7e895b.md) that lets any local app or terminal command steal the token authenticating a user's account; [Meta says it issued a hotfix](../summaries/d251fda8edd2.md), but the timing stung, days after Sensor Tower counted [902K+ downloads in six days](../summaries/9249cb0b81d7.md) and Amazon [blocked Muse from shopping on amazon.com](../summaries/41d477801352.md). Shopify went the other way, planning to let Muse [complete purchases through Shop Pay](../summaries/69da42e0e50b.md), while Meta itself was spotted giving the agent [its own mailbox](../summaries/871e8f962980.md) and opening [developer connectors](../summaries/f1a4866d11c7.md). On the defensive side, Cisco Talos open-sourced [CAIRN, a framework for classifying AI-integrated malware](../summaries/83de0b8f1486.md), already credited with identifying CLOSEDQUORUM, a hacking tool whose command-and-control polls up to four LLMs for directives. The accountability thread kept pace: British Columbia is [suing OpenAI for failing to flag the Tumbler Ridge suspect's ChatGPT activity](../summaries/a076342fd0a7.md), the antitrust suit over [agreeing to slow AI development](../summaries/de0f25c4f0ba.md) continued to reverberate, and OpenAI - urging the US to [lead global frontier-safety standards](../summaries/f8309798a19a.md) and insisting [fully autonomous RSI 'is not happening today'](../summaries/ffe9332a04f8.md) - was reported to have been [negotiating mutual stress-tests with Anthropic](../summaries/efbabf843cf6.md) before the hack. The discourse ran hot underneath: a viral essay told readers to [fear AI companies, not AI](../summaries/d8d2c72cc3e1.md), Zvi Mowshowitz's [preference cascade](../summaries/27ad5becf51a.md) kept cascading, and Zelda Williams told fans generating AI videos of her father to ['have some shame'](../summaries/40f72ef242d4.md).
